A light 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of graphics. (3) The host speaks Mandarin Chinese with moderate energy. Kojima's voice enters again, speaking Japanese with higher arousal and excitement. The piano BGM remains steady. (4) Continuous Japanese speech from Kojima explains game development details. The pace is steady with clear articulation. (5) A transition whoosh SFX plays as the audio shifts slightly to include another male voice speaking Japanese more succinctly. (6) A low-frequency atmospheric rumble and misty wind SFX represent the in-game footage, lasting for about 4 seconds before returning to studio speech. (7) High-pitched laughter and a comedic ding SFX play when Kojima discusses the 'bug' that became a feature. (8) Mandarin speech from the host returns as he asks about the sequel. (9) A sustained humming 'Hmm...' thought sound is heard, followed by Kojima's contemplative Japanese response. (10) The piano music swells slightly and then fades out as the final call-to-action text is displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process of game designer Hideo Kojima, specifically highlighting how unexpected bugs can lead to innovative game features. It uses an interview format to humanize the development process and build anticipation for future projects like Death Stranding 2.
